title: Check-In Time
intro: [excited] Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! Tonight's episode is all about the places we crash after a twelve hour park day... [sighs] my feet still hurt. It's Disney's resort hotels! Your room is ready, so let's CHECK IN.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a grand hotel lobby fantasy mashup: a soaring timber lodge atrium, tropical torches and palms, a sleek monorail gliding through a modern A-frame, an ornate brass luggage cart piled with suitcases and a glowing room key on the front desk

categories.title: Aloha, Lilo
categories.intro: [excited] Aloha! Our film category has some serious Polynesian Village energy. It's Lilo and Stitch, the 2002 animated original.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a Hawaiian beach at sunset with a surfboard in the sand, a ukulele, hibiscus flowers and a tiny blue spaceship crash-landed in the palms

clues.clue: Stitch was created as an alien experiment. What is his experiment number?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 626. [laughs] Even his number sounds a little chaotic.

clues.clue: What Hawaiian word means family, where nobody gets left behind or forgotten?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is ohana. Also the name of a famous restaurant at the Polynesian Village, with all you care to enjoy skewers.

clues.clue: Lilo is a huge fan of which singer, whose songs fill the movie's soundtrack?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elvis Presley. [chuckles] Lilo even tries to teach Stitch to be a model citizen by acting like the King. Thank you very much.

clues.clue: Which mad scientist alien created Experiment 626?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Jumba Jookiba. [mischievously] He calls it evil genius. Personally, I call it a VERY fluffy lawsuit waiting to happen.

clues.clue: What is the name of Lilo's lumpy homemade doll?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is... Scrump. Lilo made it herself, and it is adorable and terrifying at the same time.

categories.title: Room With a View
categories.intro: Let's tour the Walt Disney World resorts in PICTURES. Some of these views are worth the room rate... [laughs] some of them are a parking lot.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a hotel balcony at sunrise overlooking a sparkling lagoon with a monorail track and distant castle spires, room service tray on a small table

clues.clue: The monorail glides right through the giant A-frame building of which Walt Disney World resort?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is the Contemporary Resort. [laughs] Where else can you eat breakfast while a train zooms through the lobby?

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a sleek 1970s modern A-frame hotel tower with a monorail track running straight into a soaring indoor concourse lined with a giant tile mural

clues.clue: Which flagship resort, with white Victorian architecture and red roofs, sits on the Seven Seas Lagoon?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Grand Floridian Resort and Spa. Fancy, fancy. Pinkies up for afternoon tea.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a white Victorian seaside grand hotel with red shingled roofs and turrets on a calm lagoon at golden hour

clues.clue: At Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge, guests can watch giraffes and zebras from their balconies across grassy areas called what?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is savannas. [laughs] Waking up to a giraffe outside your window beats waking up to an alarm clock.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: giraffes and zebras grazing on a grassy savanna just below wooden balconies of an African-style lodge with thatched roofs

clues.clue: Disney's Wilderness Lodge, with its own erupting geyser, takes inspiration from which national park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yellowstone. The lodge is modeled on the Old Faithful Inn, and the geyser is a lot easier to visit.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a massive log-built national-park-style lodge beside a lake with a tall steaming geyser erupting among pine trees

clues.clue: Two resorts opened alongside Magic Kingdom on October 1, 1971: the Contemporary and which other?
clues.reveal: Drumroll, please... the correct answer is the Polynesian Village Resort. [chuckles] Over fifty years of Dole Whip on the beach. Not a bad retirement plan.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a tropical South Seas longhouse hotel with tiki torches, palm trees and a white sand beach on a lagoon at sunset

categories.title: Passport Check-In
categories.intro: Pack your bags! [excited] We're leaving Florida to visit Disney hotels around the globe, from Hawaii to Tokyo to Paris.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a stack of vintage travel suitcases covered in colorful travel stickers of a Hawaiian beach, an Italian harbor and a Paris skyline, with a world map behind

clues.clue: Which Disney resort and spa sits on the island of Oahu in Hawaii?
accept: aulani a disney resort and spa
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aulani. [mischievously] Mickey in a Hawaiian shirt is the vacation energy we all need.

clues.clue: Which Tokyo DisneySea hotel is built right into the park itself, with Italian-style architecture?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Hotel MiraCosta. Some rooms overlook the park, so you can watch the shows in your pajamas.

clues.clue: Disney's Grand Californian Hotel in Anaheim celebrates which architectural style?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Arts and Crafts, also called Craftsman style. [laughs] So much wood. So many cozy fireplaces.

clues.clue: The Disneyland Hotel's three towers are named Adventure, Frontier, and what?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Fantasy. Each tower is themed to its land, right down to the headboards that light up with fireworks.

clues.clue: Which Disneyland Paris hotel reopened in 2021 as a showcase for Marvel artwork?
accept: disney's hotel new york the art of marvel
hotel new york the art of marvel
clues.reveal: [gasps] Oh, this one is TOUGH. The correct answer is... Disney's Hotel New York, The Art of Marvel. [laughs] Superheroes in the hallways. Excelsior!

categories.title: Rhyme Time: Check-In
categories.intro: [excited] It's RHYME TIME, hotel edition! Every answer is two words that rhyme. Think fast... and tip your bellhop.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a brass hotel service bell on a polished front desk with whimsical swirling musical notes and rhyming-poem ribbons floating above it

clues.clue: A hotel just for Mickey and Minnie, which is also a nickname for the whole Disney company.
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Mouse House. Mickey's place, and also where all of our vacation money ends up.

clues.clue: A giant room service dinner delivered to the castle's furry, grumpy prince.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beast Feast. [chuckles] Be our guest, put our service to the test, and please use a napkin this time.

clues.clue: A cozy little reading corner reserved for Peter Pan's pirate nemesis.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Hook Nook. [mischievously] Just don't bring a ticking clock in there. He gets very jumpy.

clues.clue: Fantasia's magical mop-pusher, hired by housekeeping to sweep your suite.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Room Broom. Just NEVER let Mickey give it a wizard hat. The flooding is not covered by the deposit.

clues.clue: The ride of the Aladdin villain who wants to be sultan, handed over to the hotel valet.
clues.reveal: [whispers] Only the true Disney nerds got this one. The correct answer is... Jafar's Car. [laughs] Please do not tip the valet with a snake staff. Iago will want a receipt.

categories.title: Do Not Disturb
categories.intro: [yawns] After all that check-in excitement, our fan category is about Disney characters who really love a good nap. Hang that sign on the door.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a cozy fairytale bedroom at night with a canopy bed, a spinning wheel in the corner, a tiny teapot, moonlight through the window and a hanging door sign with no words, just a moon symbol

clues.clue: Which of the Seven Dwarfs can barely keep his eyes open?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleepy. Honestly, after a park day, we are all Sleepy.

clues.clue: Princess Aurora falls into an enchanted sleep after pricking her finger on what?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is the spindle of a spinning wheel. [laughs] Maleficent did not hold back on the birthday gift.

clues.clue: Which Jungle Book python sings Trust in Me while trying to hypnotize Mowgli to sleep?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kaa. Those spiral eyes are the original screensaver.

clues.clue: Which Alice in Wonderland tea party guest keeps dozing off and ends up stuffed in a teapot?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is the Dormouse. Calm him down with a little jam on his nose. That's real advice from the movie.

clues.clue: In Sleeping Beauty, which good fairy decides to put the whole kingdom to sleep until Briar Rose awakens?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] And the correct answer is... Flora, the fairy in red. [mischievously] Leadership qualities, and she's still wrong about the dress being pink.
